hook_text: Took a canoe to work today

song.title: Paddle, Paddle
song.style: English, sunny highlife with bright interlocking guitars, horns, congas and shakers, warm friendly male lead vocal, easygoing and joyful, 120 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Same grey street at half past eight
Head down, scrolling, running late
Bumped a bin and bumped a man
Every morning, same old plan

[Chorus]
Paddle, paddle, slow and wide
Let the water be my guide
Paddle, paddle, I'm okay
I took a canoe to work today

[Verse]
My phone stayed sleeping on the fridge
I found a canoe beneath the bridge
A heron nodded, ducks said hi
Floating gardens drifting by

[Chorus]
Paddle, paddle, slow and wide
My whole team came for the ride
Paddle, paddle, sun goes down
Rowing home across the town

shots.prompt: {moss} trudges down a grey drizzly street staring at a glowing phone and steps right into a deep puddle up to his knees with a big splash. The camera crash zooms in. Grey morning, warm streetlamp.
{moss} looks down at his soaked boots as water pours out of them. Close-up, the camera tilts down. Grey morning, warm streetlamp.
{moss} hurries along a grey sidewalk, head down, phone glowing in his hand. The camera tracks backward fast in front of him. Grey morning, warm streetlamp.
The hands of a big round clock on a grey wall spin fast. The camera pushes in. Grey morning light.
{moss} bumps into a round metal bin and then into a tall man in a brown suit with a big red beard carrying a coffee cup. The camera whip pans between them. Grey morning, warm streetlamp.
Coffee splashes onto the tie of a tall man in a brown suit with a big red beard, who glares down at {moss}. The camera crash zooms in. Grey morning light.
Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, sheepish and soaked, under a warm streetlamp in the drizzle. The camera pushes in. Warm streetlamp glow.
{moss} slumps at a grey office desk under a flickering lamp. The camera dolly zooms. Dim warm desk lamp.
{moss} throws open his kitchen window and sunlight floods his face, a sparkling green canal below. The camera cranes out over the canal. Bright morning sun.
A little red wooden canoe bobs at the edge of a sunny green canal. The camera pushes in. Bright morning sun.
Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, grinning and holding a wooden paddle. The camera orbits fast around him. Bright morning sun.
{moss} twirls a wooden paddle like a baton and bonks a lamp. The camera whip pans. Warm morning light.
{moss} sits in his bathtub practising paddle strokes, water splashing everywhere. The camera crash zooms in. Warm bathroom light.
A yellow rubber duck bobs in a splashing bathtub. Close-up, the camera pushes in. Warm bathroom light.
{moss} stands in his front doorway with a paddle over his shoulder like a hero, sunlight behind him. Low angle, the camera cranes up. Bright morning sun.
{moss} turns back as the phone in his hand buzzes, and looks toward the fridge. The camera pushes in. Warm morning light.

A black smartphone stands upright, face to the door, in a quilted moss-green brick stuck to a cream fridge door, a round sun-yellow badge with a closed eye on its front, a small shopping list held by a yellow magnet beside it. Soft leaf shadows sway slowly across the fridge door. Warm morning light. The camera pushes in slowly.
{moss} waves goodbye to the fridge and skips out of the kitchen with his paddle. The camera tracks with him. Warm morning light.
{moss} climbs into a little red canoe under an ivy-covered stone bridge and it rocks wildly. Low angle, the camera whips around him. Bright morning sun.
{moss} steadies himself in the canoe with his arms out, then grins. Close-up, the camera pushes in. Bright morning sun.
A tall grey heron on a wooden post nods at {moss} as he paddles past in his red canoe. The camera whip pans from the heron to him. Bright morning sun.
{moss} tips his beanie to the heron. Close-up, the camera tracks with him. Bright morning sun.
{moss} paddles past a floating garden raft full of sunflowers and tomato plants on a sparkling canal. FPV, the camera skims low over the water. Bright sun.
A gardener in denim overalls and a huge straw hat with a grey ponytail on the raft tosses {moss} a red apple and he catches it. The camera whip pans with the apple. Bright sun.
Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, paddling his red canoe down a sunlit canal. The camera tracks alongside him. Bright sun.
{moss} glides his red canoe up to a vine-covered office building on the canal and coworkers wave from the windows. The camera cranes up the building. Bright sun.
A tall man in a brown suit with a big red beard jumps into the red canoe, rocking it, laughing. The camera crash zooms in. Golden afternoon light.
A woman in a teal jumpsuit with a silver bob climbs into the canoe too and it sinks low in the water. Low angle, the camera pushes in. Golden afternoon light.

Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, in the bow of the red canoe, a tall man in a brown suit with a big red beard and a woman in a teal jumpsuit with a silver bob paddling behind him. The camera slowly pulls back. Golden hour light.
Wooden paddles dip into golden water. Close-up, the camera tracks with them. Golden hour light.
A little red canoe with three friends glides under a bridge strung with warm lanterns at dusk. FPV, the camera flies after it. Warm lantern glow.
{moss} lies back in the red canoe drifting under warm string lights and the first stars, paddle across his lap, taking a deep breath. The camera cranes slowly up. Warm glow against a deep blue dusk.

caption: moss walked to work face first into puddles. one morning the phone stayed in the Hibernator and he found a canoe. commute fixed
